items.title: 【部分CSP需求下修影响价格展望 2027年存储器产值增速放缓】金十数据11月25日讯，根据TrendForce集邦咨询最新存储器产业研究，由于部分云端服务供应
items.summary: 【部分CSP需求下修影响价格展望 2027年存储器产值增速放缓】金十数据11月25日讯，根据TrendForce集邦咨询最新存储器产业研究，由于部分云端服务供应商（CSP）下修2027年存储器订单，预计NAND Flash产业在供给续增的情况下，将进入价格下行循环，全年产值因此较先前预估下调至约4,193亿美元。DRAM市场尽管得以延续供不应求态势，但价格涨幅将逐季收敛，2027年产值预估下修至1.15万亿美元。观察NAND Flash领域，2026年第四季中旬开始，部分CSP考量GPU供给短缺，减少2027年Enterprise SSD采购需求，幅度高于北美CSP的订单成长。PC、智能手机等消费性电子则因低价库存耗尽，而且2027年面临整机涨价压力，品牌为控制BOM Cost，将全面下修搭载的NAND Flash容量规格。

items.title: CoreWeave五年期CDS单日飙升224基点，已达雷曼破产前五年期水平的1.9倍
items.summary: AI算力租赁商CoreWeave的信用风险定价急剧恶化。基于美国SEC及DTCC公开交易数据统计，其五年期信用违约互换（CDS）利差11月24日升至1320个基点，较前一交易日的1096个基点单日扩大224个基点，创该平台过去124个有成交交易日以来新高。 CDS相当于债务违约保险，利差越高，意味着投资者为对冲公司违约风险支付的成本越高。历史对照方面，雷曼兄弟2008年9月破产前，其五年期CDS利差约为710个基点，一年期则升至约1450个基点。按相同的五年期限比较，CoreWeave当前利差已达到雷曼破产前水平的约1.9倍，高出约610个基点。 不过业内人士指出，两者风险结构并不相同：雷曼破产前1年期CDS高达约1450个基点，呈剧烈的期限倒挂，反映的是迫在眉睫的流动性挤兑；而CoreWeave的高利差更多定价了市场对其高杠杆融资与中长期偿债能力的担忧。 路透11月25日援引标普全球市场情报数据报出CoreWeave五年期CDS利差1314个基点，并将其描述为处于信用困境区间。市场担忧，AI数据中心建设高度依赖债务融资，而巨额资本开支能否及时转化为收入和现金流，仍存在不确定性。

Russian oil's price advantage in India narrows as Middle East exports recover
items.summary: India's Russian crude imports are expected to fall to prewar levels this month as a recovery in Middle East exports gives buyers cheaper alternatives. Russian sellers have been slow to cut prices as Persian Gulf crude prices decline: Iraqi and Saudi grades are trading at discounts to Dubai, while Urals crude remains at a premium, according to people familiar with the matter. India's crude imports are forecast to average about 1.7 mln bpd this month, the lowest since February and nearly 40% below July's record 2.8 mln bpd, Kpler data show. Higher freight costs on the longer voyage to the Indian subcontinent are also eroding Russian crude's competitiveness.

items.summary: 【随着中东出口回升，俄罗斯石油在印度的价格优势减弱】金十数据11月25日讯，本月，印度从俄罗斯进口的原油量预计将降至俄乌冲突前的水平；与此同时，中东地区出口的复苏为买家提供了大量更廉价的供应选择。据知情人士透露，面对波斯湾石油价格的下跌，俄罗斯原油卖家在下调报价方面反应迟缓。这些人士表示，近期伊拉克和沙特的原油品种相对于迪拜基准油价均以折价出售，而俄罗斯的乌拉尔原油则仍保持溢价。据大宗商品数据分析公司Kpler的数据，本月印度原油进口量预计平均约为每天170万桶，为2月以来的最低水平，较7月份创下的每天280万桶的纪录下降了近40%。此外，由于运往印度次大陆的航程较长，高昂的运费也进一步削弱了俄罗斯石油的竞争力。

CIA, ODNI reportedly hit by cyberattack exposing some unclassified information
items.summary: The CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence recently uncovered a cybersecurity incident that exposed some unclassified information, a person familiar with the matter said. The breach affected a network used to search public, unclassified materials for intelligence leads, The New York Times first reported. The scope of exposed material is unclear, but information from other U.S. government agencies was also believed to be affected. ODNI said key capabilities and classified systems were not disrupted. The report did not say how the breach occurred.

items.summary: 【美国中央情报局和国家情报总监办公室据称部分非机密信息遭网络攻击】金十数据11月25日讯，一名知情人士称，美国中央情报局（CIA）和国家情报总监办公室（ODNI）近期发现一起网络安全事件，导致两家机构的部分非机密信息遭到泄露。据《纽约时报》最先报道，此次入侵影响了一个用于从公开、非机密材料中搜寻情报线索的网络。目前尚不清楚具体有哪些非机密材料遭到泄露，但据信美国其他政府机构的信息也在此次攻击中受到波及。针对相关报道，ODNI表示，关键能力和机密系统均未受到干扰。《纽约时报》的报道并未说明此次网络入侵是如何发生的。

items.title: 高盛：AI抛售短期未必拖累美元，中期投资降温或构成压力
items.summary: AI行情与美元走势存在较强关联，但AI抛售并不必然导致美元贬值。近期美国科技股相对全球市场走弱，美元指数却创出新高，反映出美元的避险属性正在发挥作用。高盛认为，近期美元走势主要受美国2年期国债收益率、市场风险情绪及美国相对股票回报共同驱动。若AI回调进一步扩散至全球股市，引发更广泛的下跌和波动率上升，避险资金流入美元的力量可能抵消美国股市跑输带来的负面影响，因此短期AI抛售导致美元走弱的可能性较低。但从中期看，AI投资周期见顶、未来资本开支预期下降，以及AI相关价格影响减弱，可能逐步削弱AI过去一年为美元提供的支撑。若美国股市相对其他市场的领先优势同步收窄，美元也将面临下行压力。不过，如果市场对AI投资前景的重新评估速度快于预期，美元仍可能在调整初期因避险需求而阶段性走强。

Investors are also watching PCE inflation data due later today for clues on the Federal Reserve’s policy path. The rebound was “clearly just a dead-cat bounce,” said Joachim Klement, a strategist at Panmure Liberum, adding that U.S. stocks and AI-related shares would remain under pressure as traders cut positions ahead of the Thanksgiving weekend.

items.title: 高盛：美股仓位降至“解放日”以来最低，市场更像定位重置而非投降

items.title: Australian dollar set for biggest monthly drop in more than 13 years as global stocks slide
items.summary: The Australian dollar fell more than 1% to 0.6560 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, extending its decline to 6.6% this month and putting it on track for its biggest monthly drop since May 2013 as weaker global equities curbed demand for growth-sensitive currencies. The currency briefly rose 0.4% after Australian inf data topped economists’ expectations, but quickly erased gains as Asian stocks fell. The Australian dollar appears technically oversold but may remain under pressure until risk appetite improves, said Rodrigo Catril, senior FX strategist at National Australia Bank. items.title: Analysts: China gasoline prices may return to the 7-yuan range
items.summary: China’s next domestic fuel price adjustment is due at midnight on Nov. 26. Based on current international crude prices, a cut is all but certain and could be close to the previous reduction, marking the second cut in November and the seventh this year. Zhuochuang Information estimates a reduction of about 0.35 yuan per liter as of the ninth working day; filling a 50-liter tank with 92-octane gasoline would cost about 17.5 yuan less. If implemented, 92-octane gasoline prices in many regions could fall below 8 yuan per liter and return to the 7-yuan range. This year, domestic fuel prices have seen 14 increases, six cuts and two unchanged adjustments, with gains and losses roughly offsetting.

items.title: HSBC: Sharp widening in French bond yields has eased
items.summary: HSBC is less bearish on French bonds after the sharp widening in yield spreads in October eased, European rates strategist Chris Attfield said in a report. The bank shifted its views on France and Italy to neutral and turned modestly bullish on Spain. Spreads have consolidated and much of the risk is priced in, but the French bond market remains in risk-off mode, with further widening still a risk, Attfield said. A compromise on France’s budget may not be reached until December, and even then, scope for spread tightening is limited as the presidential election approaches. HSBC expects the 10-year French-German government bond yield spread to hold at 150 bps through end-2027.

items.title: Germany Q3 GDP growth revised down to 0.1% as capital investment slumps
items.summary: Germany’s Q3 GDP grew 0.1% QoQ, below the preliminary 0.2% estimate, as capital investment fell 1.2%, the federal statistics office said Wednesday. The economy is still expected to post its strongest performance since 2022, supported by a major public-spending plan for infrastructure and defense. Exports have benefited from the global AI investment boom, while pharmaceutical demand may have been boosted ahead of new U.S. tariffs and disruption to Asian competitors from the Iran war has provided a short-term lift to German chemical firms. The tailwinds weakened in Q3, but the Bundesbank expects activity to rebound in Q4 as exports regain momentum. Government economic advisers forecast GDP growth of 1.3% this year and 1% next year.

items.title: UK household energy price cap to rise 26% from January
items.summary: UK household energy costs will jump in January as the Middle East war drives up wholesale gas and power prices, with winter demand adding further pressure. Ofgem said Wednesday the energy price cap will rise 26% to £2,166 from Jan. 1, intensifying cost-of-living pressures and potentially offsetting much of the government’s support. Prime Minister Burnham has sought to ease the burden by cutting VAT on energy bills, while October’s budget included £100 payments to millions of households. Cornwall Insight forecasts a further increase in bills in April. Since the Iran war began earlier this year, UK gas futures and power contracts have more than doubled.

items.title: Bulgaria Could Become First Euro Zone Member Fined for Excess Deficit
items.summary: The European Commission said on the 24th it will ask EU finance ministers to approve a fine for Bulgaria for failing to take effective measures to reduce its fiscal deficit. EU rules cap member states’ budget deficits at 3% of GDP. Bulgaria’s deficit rose from 3% of GDP in 2024 to 4% in 2025 and is forecast to reach 5% this year, the Commission said. Bulgaria joined the euro zone in January 2026 as its 21st member. If approved, the penalty would make it the first euro zone member fined for exceeding the deficit limit.

items.title: Tech stocks fall again, weighing on risk appetite; Treasuries rally across the curve
items.summary: Another tech-led selloff dampened global risk appetite on Wednesday, lifting U.S. Treasury prices across maturities. The 10-year yield fell 5 bps to 4.88%, while the policy-sensitive 2-year yield dropped 4 bps. Capital Economics economist Joe Maher said the equity selloff could persist, prompting investors to lower rate expectations and driving safe-haven flows into bonds. He expects Treasuries to extend gains over the next year. Some bond traders are also hedging against the risk that Fed rate hikes and falling equities significantly slow the U.S. economy—a low-probability scenario that could eventually force the Fed back toward monetary easing.

items.title: JP Morgan: Japan's largest pension fund may be nearing decision on asset allocation changes
items.summary: Japan's Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF), the world's largest pension fund, may be nearing a decision on whether to adjust its asset allocation, reviving speculation it could shift more of its ¥314 tln ($2 tln) portfolio into domestic bonds. GPIF's agenda shows its board discussed the basic portfolio on Nov. 13, the first time the topic appeared since August, JP Morgan strategist Junya Tanase said. The latest development may indicate a data review is complete and deliberations have turned to whether changes are needed. If so, the basic portfolio could be adjusted as early as 1H next year. Any increase from the current 25% target for domestic bonds could add significant demand for Japanese government bonds and support the yen.

Xpeng targets initial global deliveries of second-generation VLA in 1H 2027
items.summary: Xpeng CEO He Xiaopeng said at the company’s Nov. 25 Tech Day that it aims to begin initial global deliveries of its second-generation VLA in 1H 2027. Assisted-driving mileage exceeded 50% of total mileage in the system’s first month after rollout. From model version 6.4.0, development uses agent-led autonomous closed-loop training, boosting overall training speed 10-12-fold and enabling recursive self-improvement and model self-distillation. Xpeng said WorldGPT, X-World and X-Foresight will further strengthen world modeling and prediction, with features including all-scenario reversing recovery, support for left- and right-hand-drive markets, broader scenario coverage and customizable driving styles planned for future releases.

items.title: A-share close: Chemical pharmaceuticals outperform in down market
items.summary: China’s major A-share indexes fell after opening lower, with the Shanghai Composite down 2.03%, the Shenzhen Composite Index down 3.24% and the ChiNext down 4.19%. Chemical pharmaceuticals bucked the selloff, with more than 10 stocks hitting their daily limits. Retail shares pared earlier gains; banks, fisheries and tourism stocks were active. Semiconductors slumped, with ChangXin Technology down more than 7% and Cambricon down more than 6%. Battery stocks fell, with CATL down more than 8% to a near 19-month low. MLCC, OLED, helium, humanoid robotics and PCB shares also underperformed. Turnover across Shanghai and Shenzhen was 1.38 trillion yuan, about 272 billion yuan below the same period a day earlier. About 600 stocks rose across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing.

items.title: Australian regulator finds dozens of new suspected violations at Big Four accounting firms
items.summary: Australia’s corporate regulator said Wednesday it had uncovered dozens of new suspected audit violations, including misuse of client information and falsified audit records. After reviewing 558 audit complaints involving KPMG, PwC, Deloitte and Ernst & Young, the Australian Securities and Investments Commission is considering enforcement and regulatory action. The latest case has prompted regulatory and political scrutiny of KPMG, following whistleblower allegations this year that it shared confidential audit-client information to win business from other companies. items.title: Survey sees European stocks hitting fresh highs in 2027, with earnings as key support
items.summary: A Refinitiv poll of equity strategists and fund managers found European stocks are expected to hit record highs in 2027 despite political risks and economic uncertainty. The median forecast from the Nov. 16-24 survey puts the STOXX Europe 600 at 680 by mid-2027, more than 7% above Tuesday’s level but below the previous poll’s 695. Forecasts range from 630 to 720. The index is expected to rise further to 703 by end-2027, unchanged from the previous quarterly survey. Credit Agricole CIB analysts said they were cautiously optimistic on European stocks in 2027, citing a fragile macroeconomic backdrop, slower expected EPS growth and election-related volatility, offset by other supportive factors. Listed companies in the region are heading into their strongest earnings season in four years, with third-quarter earnings growth expected at 25% and analysts forecasting further acceleration this quarter.

items.summary: 【调查：欧洲股市料2027年再创新高，企业获利成主要支撑】金十数据11月25日讯，路透对股票市场策略师及基金经理人的调查显示，尽管面临政治风险和经济不确定性，欧洲股市预计仍将在2027年创下历史新高。根据11月16日至24日进行的调查中值，欧洲斯托克600指数到2027年年中将升至680点，较周二交易水准高出逾7%，但略低于前次调查预测的695点。预测区间介于630点至720点之间。调查中位数显示，预计该指数到明年底将进一步升至703点，与前一次季度调查的预测持平。东方汇理资产管理分析师表示，“我们对2027年欧洲股市持审慎乐观看法。EPS成长预计将放缓，宏观经济环境依然脆弱，选举周期也将加剧市场波动，但仍有一些因素可望抵销这些不利影响。”该地区上市企业即将迎来四年来表现最强劲的财报季。预计第三季获利成长25%，分析师预测本季获利增速还将进一步加快。

UBS: U.S. Treasury yields may remain rangebound as Fed has more hikes ahead
items.summary: UBS strategist Phoebe White said Treasury yields should remain relatively rangebound during the Fed’s final two rate hikes. As inflation cools and the Fed shifts to holding rates steady for an extended period, the Treasury rally should broaden and the yield curve steepen, though elevated duration supply will limit declines in longer-term yields. UBS forecasts 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields at 4.35% and 4.80%, respectively, at end-2027.

items.title: 金十快讯
JP Morgan: Asian AI supply-chain stocks may benefit from renewed confidence in Jensen Huang
items.summary: JP Morgan sees further gains in Asian tech stocks over the coming months as confidence in Jensen Huang’s leadership at NVIDIA recovers. Recent developments have eased concerns about near-term earnings downgrades across the AI supply chain. Despite tighter U.S. export restrictions, fears of a systemic slowdown in AI infrastructure spending are expected to recede. If earnings cuts do not materialize, related stocks could rise 20%-25%. Near-term beneficiaries include AI server makers, testing companies, substrate suppliers and optical firms. Open-source AI models may also gain momentum from NVIDIA’s investment in Nemotron and its broader ecosystem. Analysts remain cautious about industry consolidation and a longer-term increase in supply-chain reshoring to the United States.

items.summary: 【钛能化学股价涨停，公司回应】金十数据11月25日讯，11月25日早盘，钛能化学股价涨停。截至午间收盘，公司股价报3.72元/股，涨幅为10.06%。消息面上，钛能化学11月24日晚间公告，拟6亿元至12亿元回购公司股份，回购价格不超过5.88元/股（含），本次回购股份用于维护公司价值及股东权益。此外，市场对于钛白粉价格有涨价预期。对此，钛能化学回应，钛白粉被称为“工业味精”，属于周期性行业，目前没有发涨价函的动作，也没有明显的价格反弹迹象，属于修复阶段。钛白粉可以用作建筑涂料、汽车漆、油墨、造纸、塑料等，其本身耐温、光泽度和分散性较好。除了钛白粉外，公司主营产品还有磷酸铁，其本身是独立的周期，最近几年景气度一直比较好，2026年的景气度也是向上的。具体情况以公司公告为准。

items.title: Nearly 60% of Japanese firms say rate hikes do more harm than good, survey shows
items.summary: Japanese companies are increasingly feeling the strain of higher interest rates, with 59% saying the negative effects of rate hikes outweigh the benefits, up 14 percentage points from a December survey, according to Teikoku Databank. The Bank of Japan raised its benchmark rate in September to a 30-year high, and markets broadly expect another hike next month. It has raised rates six times since 2024, although the benchmark remains at 1.25%, low by major-economy standards. About 48% of surveyed firms said their main lender had proactively notified them of plans to raise loan rates; among those firms, 29% said rates had already increased.

items.summary: 【日本企业对加息负面影响的担忧加剧 近六成企业认为弊大于利】金十数据11月25日讯，一项最新调查显示，日本企业正越来越明显地感受到利率上升带来的压力。这再次提醒日本央行，需要密切关注金融环境的变化。根据帝国数据库周三公布的调查，近59%的企业认为加息带来的负面影响大于正面影响，较去年12月的上一次调查上升了14个百分点。日本央行9月将基准利率上调至30年来最高水平，市场普遍预计下个月将再次加息。自2024年以来，日本央行已六次上调政策利率。不过目前基准利率仍为1.25%，在主要经济体中处于较低水平。最新调查数据显示，加息的影响正在企业部门逐步扩大。调查发现，约48%的企业表示，其主要往来银行曾主动联系告知将提高贷款利率。在这些企业中，29%表示贷款利率已经上调。

items.title: AI stock selloff drives rotation, extending India’s market-leading rally
items.summary: Indian stocks surged Wednesday as renewed selling in global AI shares drove capital toward markets with less AI exposure. The NSE Nifty 50 rose as much as 1.9%, extending gains since November to more than 12%, the strongest performance among major markets. Record foreign inflows, improving corporate earnings, lower oil prices and optimism about domestic growth have supported the rally. India’s lack of AI investment opportunities had previously been cited as a drag on equities. “At this point, however, that has become an advantage,” said Dong Chen, Asia chief investment officer at J. Safra Sarasin. Global funds have poured nearly $14 bln into Indian stocks since November, putting monthly inflows on course for a record.

items.title: French parliament passes 2026 budget, giving minority government brief respite
items.summary: France's National Assembly passed the 2026 budget late Tuesday, giving the minority government temporary breathing room as it seeks parliamentary approval for further deficit-reduction measures. The year-end budget adds spending commitments for farmers, defense, schools and overseas territories, and formally confirms the deficit will reach 5.4% of GDP, missing the government's initial target of a slight reduction to 5%. Opposition lawmakers are resisting measures to curb spending and raise taxes in 2027. Debate on next year's budget is set to intensify in December, but passage appears highly unlikely in the deeply divided Assembly, five months before the presidential election.

items.title: 【法国国民议会通过2026年预算案 少数派政府暂获喘息】金十数据11月25日讯，法国国民议会当地时间周二深夜通过2026年预算案，为正努力争取议会批准进一步削减
items.summary: 【法国国民议会通过2026年预算案 少数派政府暂获喘息】金十数据11月25日讯，法国国民议会当地时间周二深夜通过2026年预算案，为正努力争取议会批准进一步削减财政赤字措施的少数派政府暂时赢得喘息空间。 这项立法通常只是对财政年度进行收尾调整的例行程序，涉及的内容较为有限。但如今该法案已成为更广泛议会对峙的一部分。 在野党议员正抵制少数派政府为控制财政支出、提高2027年税收而采取的举措。在2026年年终预算中，政府新增了对农民、国防、学校和海外领地的支出承诺。该法案还正式确认法国未能实现财政赤字目标，赤字占GDP的比例扩大至5.4%，而政府最初目标是将这一比例小幅降至5%。明年预算案的争论将在12月进入关键阶段，届时主要预算案将重新提交国民议会审议。与2026年年终预算案不同，距离总统选举仅剩五个月之际，分裂严重的国民议会几乎不可能通过这项法案。

items.title: FT: EU plans to raise up to €50 bln for AI and quantum technology fund
items.summary: The EU is drawing up plans for a fund to make large-scale, high-risk, long-term investments in European AI and quantum computing companies, the FT reported. The proposed sovereign technology equity fund would take bigger risks and invest over longer periods than existing EU funding programs. The European Commission plans to unveil a quantum strategy on Wednesday and publish operating details for the fund next February. Funding arrangements are still under discussion; the EU aims to use public money as seed capital to attract private investment, targeting up to €6 in additional funding for every €1 invested.

items.summary: 【英媒：欧盟拟筹资500亿欧元设立新基金 投资人工智能和量子计算】金十数据11月25日讯，据英国《金融时报》，欧盟正在制定计划，拟为一项新基金筹集最高500亿欧元，用于对欧洲人工智能和量子计算企业进行长期、高风险投资。据两名参与相关讨论的官员透露，拟议中的主权科技股权基金将比欧盟现有融资计划进行规模更大、风险更高、投资期限更长的投资。官员表示：“这些都是针对高风险领域的长期稳定投资。这与欧盟通常的做法恰恰相反，而这正是我们需要设立该基金的原因。”基金投资将主要集中在人工智能和量子计算领域。欧盟委员会计划于周三公布一项量子战略，希望借此增强欧盟在这一新兴产业中的地位。相关官员表示，欧盟计划于明年2月公布新基金的具体运作细节。新基金的具体融资安排仍在讨论之中。欧盟委员会计划将欧盟资金作为启动资金，吸引私营部门追加投资，目标是每投入1欧元撬动最高6欧元的额外资金。

items.title: Trump administration shelves plan to use business deals to end Russia-Ukraine war, FT reports
items.summary: The Trump administration has quietly shelved proposals to use commercial deals to persuade Russia to end the war in Ukraine after the Kremlin showed little interest in U.S. energy and aviation projects, the Financial Times reported. U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff have told European officials that business cooperation is no longer a central U.S. offer to Moscow, with talks now focused on territory and security. Earlier proposals included U.S. investment in Russian oil and titanium projects and resuming pipeline gas deliveries to Europe. Moscow initially saw potential deals as a way to keep Trump engaged in negotiations, but its interest has waned as it insists Ukraine cede territory and make other concessions that Kyiv considers unacceptable.

items.title: Goldman Sachs: Bank of Korea may deliver hawkish hold on Thursday
items.summary: Goldman Sachs economists expect the Bank of Korea to deliver a “hawkish hold” on Thursday, with strong third-quarter headline growth and still-elevated inflation likely to keep its outlook hawkish. But weak domestic consumption and labor-market conditions, alongside subdued non-tech sectors, could keep the bank on hold. The economists said current domestic conditions do not warrant rapid rate hikes, as private consumption weakened in the third quarter and equities extended their pullback from October.

items.title: Attack on power infrastructure causes widespread outages across five southwestern Colombian provinces
items.summary: A terrorist attack damaged two power circuits connected to a substation on the evening of Nov. 24, disconnecting it from Colombia’s national grid and causing widespread outages across Nariño, Putumayo, Cauca, Huila and Caquetá, the presidential office said. The government said the attack was a response to recent security operations and ordered an immediate special protection plan for power and natural gas infrastructure nationwide. Power has been gradually restored in some affected areas.

items.title: Tech CDS costs surge as AI infrastructure returns come under scrutiny
items.summary: Credit-default swap costs for technology companies have surged as investors worry delayed returns on AI infrastructure investment could pressure borrowers. With the AI investment boom reliant on debt financing, investors are closely watching credit markets; signs of rising lender concern or tighter corporate financing could cloud the spending outlook. SoftBank Group’s five-year CDS spread jumped to 501 bps, its highest since October 2022, according to Markit. Overnight, five-year CDS spreads for Oracle, Alphabet, SpaceX and CoreWeave hit record highs, lifting CoreWeave’s implied five-year default probability to 68%, S&P Global Market Intelligence data showed.

items.summary: 【据悉贝莱德牵头财团正考虑下调Stack亚太数据中心收购报价】金十数据11月25日讯， 据外媒报道，知情人士透露，由贝莱德和IFM Investors Pty参与组成的财团正考虑下调对Stack Infrastructure旗下亚太地区数据中心资产的收购报价，原因是行业波动性日益加剧。 包括由贝莱德支持的人工智能基础设施合作伙伴（AIP）在内的投资者集团可能会削减报价中的股权部分，并有可能将部分款项的支付与项目的交付挂钩。潜在的交易调整正值数据中心行业面临多重不确定性之际。当地社会对数据中心项目的反对声浪日益高涨，加之市场对计算能力需求规模存在不确定性，使相关资产的估值更加困难。交易标的为Stack在亚太地区的数据中心资产，此前报道表示，交易可能使整个资产组合的企业价值达到200亿至250亿美元。不过知情人士指出，扣除债务和资本支出后，报价中的股权部分将明显低于这一估值。

items.title: 德银：美股不具备以往熊市的条件，估值压力是主要风险
items.summary: 德意志银行宏观策略师Henry Allen表示，过去50年标普500跌幅达到20%的熊市，通常至少伴随三项因素之一：经济衰退、市场普遍形成衰退预期，或美联储经历多轮加息后的货币紧缩。目前美国尚未出现类似的宏观条件。 德银预计2027年美国经济增长2.3%，全球增长3.5%；11月美国综合PMI为54.6，仍处于扩张区间。与此同时，市场对2027年9月前美联储累计加息的定价为66个基点，低于10月6日标普500创历史新高时的82个基点，显示近期股市下跌并未伴随货币政策预期进一步收紧。 当前科技股调整虽令人联想到2000年互联网泡沫破裂，但当年美股熊市发生时，美国经济已进入衰退。若本轮市场在缺乏衰退、衰退预期及货币紧缩的情况下进入熊市，将是历史上较罕见的情形。1962年肯尼迪执政期间的美股大跌是较接近的先例，当时标普500从高点下跌28%，主要受到估值过高影响。（德意志银行11月24日报告，仅供参考，不构成投资建议）

Retail stocks advanced, with several names including Nanjing Central Emporium, Hangzhou Jiebai and Gansu Guofang limit-up. items.title: Goldman sees U.S. data center power demand growth lasting through 2028
items.summary: U.S. data center power capacity could continue growing rapidly through 2028, Goldman Sachs said in a report Tuesday, with the AI boom driving larger facilities with higher power density. Goldman sees 52 GW of additional data center capacity in 2028. U.S. data center capacity and demand have risen nearly 30% year to date, accounting for more than one-third of growth in total U.S. electricity demand, the bank said. Rapid expansion could tighten U.S. power markets further and boost natural gas demand, reinforcing Goldman’s bullish outlook for Henry Hub prices in 2028-30. Potential policy shifts after the midterm elections could temper demand upside: a Democratic victory is expected to produce a divided government and may prompt stricter scrutiny of data center construction by regulators and policymakers.

items.summary: 【高盛：美国数据中心电力需求增长或持续至2028年】金十数据11月25日讯，高盛在周二发布的报告中表示，美国数据中心电力容量的强劲增长势头可能持续至2028年。随着人工智能热潮推动更多规模更大、单位面积电力密度更高的数据中心设施建设，电力和天然气需求面临进一步上行风险。高盛预计，2028年可能新增52吉瓦的数据中心电力容量。高盛表示：“今年以来美国数据中心电力容量和需求增长近30%，贡献了美国电力总需求增量的逾三分之一。”数据中心快速扩张可能进一步加剧美国电力市场的供需紧张，并推高天然气需求，从而强化高盛对2028年至2030年亨利枢纽天然气价格的看涨预期。不过中期选举后的潜在政策变化可能缓和需求上行风险。民主党在中期选举中取得胜利预计将促成分裂政府，并可能导致监管机构和政策制定者对数据中心建设进行更严格的审查。

items.title: Japan corporate services prices rise at fastest pace in 36 years, potentially paving way for BOJ hike next month
items.summary: Japan’s corporate services price growth accelerated to its fastest pace since 1990, adding to the case for another BOJ rate hike next month. Prices rose 4.2% YoY in October, up from a revised 3.8% in September. Shipping costs surged 120.4% YoY amid the Iran war, the biggest increase since records began in 1986. The acceleration may deepen BOJ concerns that underlying inf is running above its 2% target. Services price gains also show the Middle East conflict passing cost pressures on to businesses, potentially keeping inf elevated for households. “Companies are continuing to pass on higher labor costs,” said Kenichiro Ahara, an economist at Dai-ichi Life Research Institute. But price increases in labor-intensive industries remain below the broader services-sector pace. “We need to closely assess whether labor costs are being passed on across more industries and whether that will drive sustained services price increases,” he said.

items.summary: 【日本企业服务价格涨幅创36年新高 或促使日本央行下月再度加息】金十数据11月25日讯，日本企业服务价格涨幅升至1990年以来最高水平，为日本央行下个月再次加息提供了又一理由。周三报告显示，10月份企业服务价格同比上涨4.2%，高于前一个月经修正后的3.8%。受伊朗战争影响，海运成本同比飙升120.4%，创下自1986年有相关数据记录以来的最大涨幅。这一加速走势可能进一步加剧日本央行对潜在通胀率超过2%目标的担忧。服务价格大幅上涨也表明，中东冲突正将成本压力传导至企业，并可能使家庭继续面临较高通胀。第一生命经济研究所经济学家Kenichiro Ahara表示：“企业仍在持续转嫁上涨的劳动力成本。”不过，劳动密集型行业的价格涨幅仍低于整体服务业价格涨幅。他表示：“我们需要仔细审视，劳动力成本的传导是否正在更多行业持续发生，以及是否会推动服务价格持续上涨。”

items.title: Optimism over Jensen Huang’s comeback fades as Asian tech stocks tumble again
items.summary: Optimism over a turnaround in Jensen Huang’s fortunes quickly faded in Asian markets on Wednesday as investors refocused on risks to the global AI trade. Taiwan’s Taiex fell as much as 8.6%, nearly erasing Tuesday’s 9% gain, while TSMC plunged more than 9%. South Korea’s Kospi dropped 6%, dragged down by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The sharp reversal in tech-heavy Asian markets underscored fragile investor appetite for AI stocks. Concerns over funding for AI infrastructure and the impact of heavy capex on major companies’ earnings remain, regardless of Huang’s position. The selloff reflected both valuation resets and synchronized position unwinding, said Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo Markets. Tuesday’s rebound may have offered investors a chance to exit positions rather than a signal to rebuild them, she said.

items.summary: 【科研团队用脑机接口治疗难治性抑郁症】金十数据11月25日讯，11月24日，浙江大学计算机学院与双脑中心脑机接口团队联合南湖脑机交叉研究院、脑机智能全国重点实验室、杭州青石永隽医疗设备有限公司、浙江大学医学院附属第二医院、浙江大学医学院附属第一医院、杭州市第七人民医院等单位，发布了面向难治性抑郁症精准治疗的侵入式脑机接口系统——DeepAxtiv。已开展的临床试验表明，DeepAxtiv的疗效大幅优于当前国际同行平均水平，标志着我国侵入式脑机接口在重大精神疾病精准治疗赛道实现关键性突破。

items.title: U.S. ambassador says Australia’s digital regulation bill could restrict free speech
items.summary: The U.S. ambassador to Australia said a proposed law regulating major tech companies would restrict free speech and impose an unfair burden on U.S. firms, setting the stage for a dispute between the two countries. Australia’s Digital Duty of Care Bill is expected to pass parliament this week. It would require digital service providers to build safety measures into product design and raise the maximum penalty for violations to 5% of global revenue. Ambassador David Brat said on social media that the bill and its fines would “force platforms to censor lawful speech.” He said the United States was concerned the rules would impose a disproportionate compliance burden on U.S. companies compared with their competitors.

items.title: AI chip export windfall may extend won's rally
items.summary: South Korea's AI chip boom is set to trigger a year-end wave of foreign-exchange inflows that could fuel another leg of won appreciation. SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics are expected to convert most export proceeds into won to fund dividends and employee bonuses, while surging AI hardware revenue will also increase their won needs for tax payments. Macro Hive and Korea Investment & Securities expect the inflows to lift the won into the 1,200-per-dollar range by the end of 1H 2027. Goldman Sachs sees the won strengthening to 1,280 per dollar next year, about 5% stronger than Wednesday's level. Foreign investors' dividend repatriation could create near-term selling pressure, but record exports and a large current-account surplus should support the won in 2027. Exporters still have substantial dollar holdings to sell, said Vivek Rajpal, Asia strategist at Singapore-based JB Drax Honore, adding that the won's rally has room to extend despite weak sentiment toward AI stocks.

items.summary: 【国台办：反对“台独”是发展两岸关系最重要的政治基础】金十数据11月25日讯，国务院台办举行例行新闻发布会，有记者问：中俄美三国元首在深圳举行历史性会晤并发表《和平宣言》。请问这对台海和平稳定有何影响?发言人张晗表示，三国元首历史上首次举行面对面的会晤，意义重大，影响深远，是载入史册的标志性事件。台湾问题是中国内政，解决台湾问题是中国人自己的事，两岸同胞血脉相连、血浓于水，是一家人。一家人相处，只要有话好好说，有事多商量，就没有化解不了的矛盾分歧。坚持一个中国原则和“九二共识”，反对“台独”是发展两岸关系最重要的政治基础。我们愿在坚持一个中国原则和“九二共识”的基础上，加强两岸交流合作，深化两岸融合发展，增进同胞利益福祉，共创祖国统一、民族复兴美好未来。

items.title: Taiwan Affairs Office: Xi-Trump meeting sets new strategic direction for China-U.S. ties
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump set new strategic guidance for China-U.S. ties at their Nov. 19 meeting in Shenzhen, a Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson said. Trump said the United States does not support Taiwan independence. Beijing urged Washington to uphold the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiques, put its opposition to Taiwan independence into practice and prevent the Taiwan issue from disrupting bilateral ties.

items.title: LME copper, tin tumble as AI rally fades
items.summary: LME copper and tin slumped on Tuesday, erasing the previous session’s gains and hitting eight-month lows. Aluminum fell to a 13-month low. Three-month copper dropped 6.03% to $11,790.50 a metric ton after touching $11,760, its lowest since March 23. Panmure Liberum analysts said investors had not fully rebuilt positions held before Jensen Huang’s resignation and remained cautious amid high copper-market volatility. Three-month tin plunged 8.3% to $39,110, its biggest one-day fall since March and its first close below $40,000 since December. Sucden Financial analysts said fresh buying would be needed to sustain a base-metals rebound after the initial rally fades.

items.summary: 【LME铜锡暴跌，因人工智能涨势消退】金十期货11月25日讯，据外媒报道，周二，伦敦金属交易所（LME）的期铜和期锡均大幅下跌，将上个交易日的涨幅系数回吐，并创下8个月来的最低价。铝价也跌至13个月低点。LME三个月期铜下跌6.03%，报每吨11790.50美元。盘中一度触及11760美元，创下3月23日以来的最低价格。英国投资银行Panmure Liberum的分析师表示，投资者并未完全恢复黄仁勋辞职前的持仓，其中包括大宗商品的持仓。投资者仍在观望，认为铜市波动很大。作为另一种受益于AI建设的金属，LME的三个月期锡暴跌8.3%，报每吨39110美元，创下3月份以来的最大单日跌幅，也是去年12月以来首次跌破40000美元。苏克敦金融公司的分析师认为，一旦最初的反弹消退，基础金属想要出现更持续的反弹，将需要新的买盘兴趣。

items.title: Report: NVIDIA AI GPU lead times lengthen; RTX 60 mass production may be delayed
items.summary: NVIDIA’s AI products remain in tight supply, with Taiwan-based ODMs reporting sharply longer lead times for new B300 and GB300 orders, according to the Commercial Times. Workstation-class superchips now have lead times of about 26 weeks, further squeezing consumer GPU supply. NVIDIA is reportedly set to reduce GeForce RTX 50-series shipments, while mass production of the RTX 60 series, targeted for late 2027, may be delayed. B300 GPU lead times are 26-40 weeks and GB300 lead times about 14-26 weeks. Most orders placed over the next two quarters are expected to ship no earlier than Q2 or Q3 next year.

items.title: Trump says he would pardon Jensen Huang if needed, is open to U.S. stake in NVIDIA
items.summary: Trump told the New York Post he would pardon NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang if necessary, but expected Huang to be fine without a pardon and said he should tell the truth when he testifies to Congress next week. Trump said Huang need not invoke the Fifth Amendment. He called NVIDIA’s success vital to maintaining U.S. leadership in AI and said he had considered, but had not proposed, the U.S. government taking an equity stake in the company, adding that it might not be too late. NVIDIA shares recouped some losses on Tuesday afternoon after surging on Monday.
